problem_type: Unvalidated persisted draft and partially published recovery identity
symptom: Damaged saved payment edits throw on recovery and a subsequent poll can attach the previous request draft.
direct_cause: typeof admits null and arrays; refresh advances draftOwner before restoration can throw.
class_root: Persisted editable input must validate before consumption and request ownership must publish only after recovery succeeds.
internal_only_reason: Application-owned localStorage shape and React publication order; no third-party runtime defect.
invariants: Only structurally valid drafts reach merge, pricing and revision consumers.
Valid user input is returned without normalization or storage mutation by the parser.
Failed recovery never publishes a new owner with an old draft.

door_reduction.why_not: The ledger parser owns stored input validation; the existing hook owns atomic publication of the restored request. Both remain necessary.

generality_proof: All exact, dismissed and partial reads use readSpendDraft; the only restore caller computes recovery before committing owner or pending state.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Validate persisted draft and nested editable patches with the existing reference contract.
Publish a changed request identity only after its draft restores successfully.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Exact quote, dismissed scope and partial-shot reads converge on readSpendDraft.
Recovery-entry upkeep reads saved partial drafts through readSpendDraft before draftIsEmpty.

recurrence.reason: Any corrupt stored JSON or storage write exception can recur across requests and machines.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs readSpendDraft: four direct calls aggregated in ledger owner
node scripts/door-map.mjs restoreSpendDraft: existing hook caller
Inspected shared spendReferenceInputSchema and different generationPlan candidatePatch contract

prevention.invariant: No malformed draft crosses the persistence boundary; no request identity publishes before recovery succeeds.
prevention.failure_mode: Invalid stored shape returns existing empty sentinel without parser writes; restoration write errors keep the existing explicit missing-card failure and retry on next refresh.
prevention.strategy: Validate at the original ledger read boundary and compute restoration before publishing hook state.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replaces the permissive typeof-only check at the existing entry; no parallel storage owner.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing Zod dependency and application contracts suffice; no upstream defect.

migration: No storage rewrite. Valid persisted drafts retain their exact values. Malformed records are not admitted to consumers.
residual_risks: Controlled browser recovery regression passed in the parent serial run; no final Electron or live provider acceptance is claimed.
